description: This file defines culture-specific date and time formatting information for the 'az-Cyrl-AZ' (Azeri Cyrillic, Azerbaijan) locale, including day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing, and date prototype extensions.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Object containing culture-specific date and time formatting details for 'az-Cyrl-AZ'.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to the current time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current day with time cleared.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
